ambiguity.detail: Clarissa addresses Juliana as sister, establishing deep family betrayal.

verdict.hook_line: I want to see you crawl, sister.
verdict.cliffhanger_line: Tell me where the garden is.
verdict.viewer_takeaway: A sadistic sister forces a devoted wife to mutilate her hands in thorny briars to save her husband from execution.
verdict.why_it_works: High emotional blackmail and clear physical stakes provide maximum vertical-video retention.
